name: fsr-ai-eval-stub
label: FSR AI Eval Stub
description: Hosts scenario-driven stub MCP servers on the appliance (127.0.0.1 only) so AI investigations can be scored against known ground truth. Built and driven by pyfsr.ai_eval.

fields.title: Listener Port
fields.name: port
fields.tooltip: Local TCP port the stub MCP listener binds on 127.0.0.1.
fields.description: Local TCP port the stub MCP listener binds on 127.0.0.1.

fields.title: Bearer Token
fields.name: token
fields.tooltip: Optional. When set, MCP requests must send Authorization: Bearer <token>.
fields.description: Optional. When set, MCP requests must send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

operations.title: Load Fixtures
operations.description: Replace the stub servers' fixtures (JSON {servers:{...}}) and make sure the listener is running.

operations.title: Get Call Log
operations.description: Return every MCP tool call the stub servers answered, optionally since a UNIX timestamp, optionally clearing the log.

parameters.title: Since (UNIX seconds)
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Only calls at or after this time.
parameters.description: Only calls at or after this time.

operations.title: Server Status
operations.description: Report whether the listener is up and which stub servers it serves.

operations.title: Start Server
operations.description: Start the listener if it is not running.
